cohort: 3852 premature neonates (<37 weeks) admitted to newborn intensive care units (NICUs) in 5 hospitals in Ethiopia from July 2016 to May 2018.
finding: Hypothermia at admission is associated with neonatal mortality in premature neonates in Ethiopia.
followup_time: Duration of NICU stay (variable, up to May 2018 from admission between July 2016 and May 2018)
